extraction.Name: Romena Jensen
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee, for she knew she could not pay the taxes, but took it on the advise of the Farme: and Superintendent, who told her that she would lose the land if she did not take it and pay the taxes
extraction.Recorded patent: she did not have the papers recorded, but that it was done by Thomas Arnold, now of Merriman, Nebr.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold her allotment to Thomas Arnold of Merriman, Nebr for 4480.00
extraction.Buyer: Thomas Arnold of Merriman, Nebr. for $4480.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: this was the best she could do, as she was about to lose the land for taxes
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent but in very poor health; has nothing, no home and is living on the allotment of her son; has received no aid from the Government, County or State since she was given her patent; has seven minor children depending on her for support; husband is an invalid and unable to do much work but works what he can; deponent thinks the land should have been worth $6400.00; document sworn November 13, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge (Shannon County, South Dakota)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
